A1.justification: Both PDFs describe HiconAgent and HCPO. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-H support a complete comparison. The appendices match exactly after accounting for a one-page shift.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, history-length and token-drop experiments, ablations, training curves, and qualitative case studies in Sections 4 and 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including HiconAgent evaluations on AndroidControl-High, AITW, and GUI-Odyssey, alongside the same ablations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E retain the same dynamic context sampling, dual-branch history compression, KL alignment, reward design, and training algorithm. No component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use AMEX for training and AndroidControl-High, AITW, and GUI-Odyssey for evaluation. The qualitative navigation scenarios in the main text and appendices also remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 retain the same GPT-4o, Qwen2.5VL, GUI-R1, OS-Atlas, UI-shift, UI-AGILE, and infiGUI comparisons. Ablation comparators also match. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The versions retain the same evaluation splits, metrics, 3,000 sampled AMEX interaction steps, model configuration, training settings, two-step history window, default compression depth, and evaluation prompts.

E4.justification: History-length and token-drop probes, sampling and component ablations, compression-depth sensitivity, per-action analyses, training curves, and qualitative cases remain unchanged in Sections 4 and 6.3 and the appendices.

E5.justification: Rollout averaging and statistical displays are unchanged. Neither version adds seed-based variability, independent-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. For example, Table 2 retains HiconAgent SR values of 52.40, 51.91, and 50.11 on AndroidControl-High, AITW, and GUI-Odyssey, respectively, with a 51.47 average. Appendix results also remain identical.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, GRPO and HCPO objectives, reward definitions, and Appendix B sampling schedule remain unchanged, including Equations 1-8. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about adaptive history use, action anchors, performance against larger agents, and computational savings.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning distracting history, action tokens carrying visual information, and the benefits of DCS and compression training are unchanged. No new limitations, applicability boundaries, or failure conditions are introduced.

D1.justification: Section 6.1 and Appendices B, C, E, and F retain identical implementation settings, data preparation, sampling parameters, algorithm details, and prompt templates. The stated code repository link is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 expands its citation lists, and the bibliography grows from 43 to 56 entries, adding works including PersonalAlign, Mirage-1, and Optimus-2/3. These additions do not expand the explanatory discussion or revise HCPO's novelty positioning.

P1.justification: The author block adds Shenzhen Loop Area Institute as an affiliation for Rui Shao and updates affiliation superscripts. Apart from citation changes, the prose, terminology, section organization, and appendix structure are retained.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation block and longer citation lists cause local layout changes. The bibliography reflows onto an additional page, shifting the unchanged appendices. Figures 1-11 and Tables 1-6 retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: v2 mainly updates affiliations and expands bibliographic pointers within unchanged related-work prose. The method, experimental evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the complete appendices. These limited edits produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
